title: particle_functions
description: Closed, versioned registry of particle CLASSES (学校文法 / 日本語教育) and particle USAGES (one meaning of one particle), plus the templates every particle explanation is rendered from. This file is both the JSON Schema (keywords at the root and in $defs) and the data (schema_version, classes, usages, templates, cues, cue_lexicons); it validates against itself. Documentation: design/particle_functions.md. Adding a usage is inserting a row, never a schema change.

locale_text.description: Locale-object (design/i18n.md): pt-BR is the learner locale, en the source locale; more locales add keys.

level.description: JLPT-style level as DATA (N5..N1 today, open-ended).

particle_class.description: Grammatical class of the particle IN THIS USAGE (と is case, parallel or conjunctive depending on use).

usage_id.description: '<key>.<usage>'; key = Hepburn romaji of the particle's kana SPELLING (は=ha, を=wo, へ=he), so the key is injective over surfaces.

unidic_pos_fine.description: Sudachi/UniDic 助詞 subclasses that realise this class; the validator's cross-check.

allomorphs.description: Other surfaces of the SAME usage (ん for の, で for て, ぐらい for くらい). For a compound, the remaining tokens in order.

compound.description: true = the usage spans several tokens (までに, ので, について); annotations then carry `positions`.

ja_term.description: The term Japanese grammar references use (時, 到達点, 相手 ...).

desc.description: Slot text the template inserts as {desc}.

role.description: Role the particle assigns to the chunk it closes.

level.description: Level at which this usage is first taught (consensus, not official).

pattern.description: Pattern hint: N = noun, V = verb, A = i-adjective, Na = na-adjective, S = clause, Num = number.

cues.description: Mechanical context cues that select this usage (see `cues`).

contrasts.description: Usages a learner confuses this one with; the distractor source for choice exercises.

interchangeable.description: Usages that are ALSO correct in the same slot (に/へ with a motion verb). A choice exercise must never offer one of these as a wrong answer.

particle_annotation.description: Target shape of ONE entry of a sentence's particles[] after migration. `usage` is the mechanical claim; `explanation` is RENDERED from usages[usage].template + slots; `note` is the only free text and is optional.

position.description: C-mode token position of the particle (binds the row to its token; today's export omits it).

positions.description: Compound usages only: every token the usage spans, in order.

function_type.description: Kept for compatibility; must equal usages[usage].class.

usage_status.description: How the usage was assigned (research/reports/particle_taxonomy_research.md §4). W46 apply: `auto` = derived mechanically; `verified` = ruled and confirmed by an independent verifier; `ruled` = the verifier's correction; `held` = no verified id (usage null, legacy explanation kept).

chunk.description: Slot value: the chunk the particle closes (chunk_head() of derive_layerb_templates_v2).

left.description: Slot value: the clause the particle closes (conjunctive/nominalizer).

expression.description: Slot value: the compound or fixed expression.

grammar.description: Optional grammar-point ref when the usage is taught as a grammar point.

cues.aux.causative: the first predicate of the clause is followed by the auxiliary せる/させる
cues.aux.passive: the first predicate of the clause is followed by the auxiliary れる/られる
cues.clause-final: the particle is followed by nothing, a period, or a sentence-final particle
cues.clause.ichiban: the clause contains 一番 / 最も
cues.clause.negative: a negation (ない, ぬ, ず, ん, ません) occurs before the next comma or period
cues.next.case-particle: next token is a particle (が, を, は, に, で ...)
cues.next.comparison: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon COMPAR (同じ, 違う, 比べる ...)
cues.next.copula: next token is だ / です / でしょう / じゃ / な (のだ, んです)
cues.next.emotion: next token lemma is in lexicon EMO or is すみません / ありがとう / 嬉しい / 残念
cues.next.issho: next token lemma is 一緒 or 共
cues.next.motion-verb: next token lemma is 行く / 来る / 帰る / 出かける / 戻る
cues.next.nai-aru: next token (skipping は/も) is ない / ある as adjective, verb or auxiliary
cues.next.naru-suru: next token lemma is なる / する / 変わる / 変える
cues.next.not-saying-verb: next predicate is NOT a verb of saying (tells topic って from quotative って)
cues.next.noun: next token is nominal (名詞, 代名詞, 数詞, 接尾辞, 接頭辞)
cues.next.predicate: next token is a verb, adjective or na-adjective (the の sits inside a noun-modifying clause)
cues.next.standard-predicate: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon STANDARD (近い, いい, 似る ...)
cues.next.start-verb: first predicate of the clause is 始まる / 開始 / 始める (formal より)
cues.next.stative-predicate: first predicate of the clause is a stative predicate (好き, 分かる, できる, 欲しい ...) or is followed by たい
cues.next.subsidiary: next token is a verb/adjective/auxiliary whose lemma is in lexicon SUBSID (いる, おく, しまう, みる, ください ...)
cues.next.temorau: the first predicate of the clause is followed by て + もらう/いただく
cues.next.use-evaluate: first predicate of the clause is 使う / 便利 / いい / 必要 / 役立つ
cues.not.clause-final: the particle is followed by more of the sentence
cues.prev.adjective: previous token is an i-adjective (形容詞)
cues.prev.adjective-or-noun: previous token is an i-adjective or a nominal
cues.prev.adverb: previous token is an adverb (副詞) or a タリ-type 形状詞
cues.prev.cause-noun: previous token lemma is in lexicon CAUSE_N (病気, 風邪, 事故 ...)
cues.prev.continuative: previous token is a verb in the continuative (連用形) inflection
cues.prev.interrogative: previous token lemma is in lexicon INTERROG (何, 誰, どこ, いつ, and minimizers 一つ, 少し ...)
cues.prev.manner-noun: previous token lemma is in lexicon MANNER (一人, みんな, 自分 ...)
cues.prev.masen: the two previous tokens are ませ + ん
cues.prev.means-noun: previous token lemma is in lexicon MEANS, or is a noun ending in 語 (a language)
cues.prev.na-stem: previous token is 形状詞 (na-adjective stem), or a noun whose third POS field is 形状詞可能
cues.prev.noun-next.noun: previous and next tokens are both nominal
cues.prev.number: previous token is a numeral (数詞), or a counter suffix right after a numeral
cues.prev.particle: previous token is itself a particle (には, では, とは, からは ...)
cues.prev.period-next.number: previous token is a period noun (日, 週, 週間, 月, 年, 時間) and the next token is a numeral
cues.prev.predicate: previous token is a verb, adjective, na-adjective or auxiliary (the particle closes a clause)
cues.prev.preface-lemma: one of the two previous tokens has a lemma in lexicon PREFACE (すみません, 失礼, 悪い ...)
cues.prev.sou-desu: the two previous tokens are そう + です
cues.prev.ta: previous token is the auxiliary た
cues.prev.te: previous token is the conjunctive particle て/で
cues.prev.time-noun: previous token lemma is in lexicon TIME, or is a time counter (時, 分, 日, 月, 年, 曜日)
cues.prev.verb-terminal: previous token is a verb in terminal/attributive form (the two are homophonous before a 終助詞)
cues.prev.volitional-or-te: previous token is the volitional う/よう, an imperative, or て/で
cues.sentence.two-ha: the sentence contains two or more は
cues.sentence.two-mo: the sentence contains two or more も
cues.verb.departure: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon DEPART
cues.verb.emotion-cause: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon EMO
cues.verb.existence: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon EXIST
cues.verb.giving-telling: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon GIVE
cues.verb.make: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon MAKE
cues.verb.motion: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon MOTION
cues.verb.path: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon PATH
cues.verb.receiving: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon RECEIVE
cues.verb.reciprocal: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon RECIP
cues.verb.saying: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon SAYING
cues.verb.target: first predicate of the clause has a lemma in lexicon TARGET
